answer: The monthly common charge is $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026. Set by board minutes of January 20, 2026 (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf), motion carried 3-0. Before that: $225 from March 1, 2025. A notice of Feb 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error. From almanac v1.
In July 2025 the charge was $225 per unit, effective March 1, 2025, set by minutes-2025-01-23.pdf (3-0). The $230 notice was an error, corrected in minutes-2025-04-15.docx. From almanac v1.

Up to two pets per unit, with registration. There is no weight limit: the 35 lb limit for dogs was removed. Set by minutes-2025-04-15.docx, carried 3-0. Before Apr 15, 2025: one pet, dogs up to 35 lb (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf). From almanac v1.

Yes, on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., since July 15, 2024. Set by minutes-2024-06-12.docx (3-0), announced in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf. Sundays and holidays remain prohibited. From almanac v1.
Yes, with written board approval, if the unit is floor-mounted (not on the railing) and rated at 60 dB(A) or less. Set by minutes-2025-01-23.pdf, carried 2-1. From almanac v1.

No. Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, House Rule 7). Electric barbecues were discussed at the June 2026 meeting recording, but this is provisional and not adopted in any minutes. From almanac v1.

The documents disagree, so this is an open conflict. Minutes of Sep 10, 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf) set 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. for the 2026 season; the notice of May 1, 2026 (notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf) says 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. The board should confirm. From almanac v1.
The minimum lease term is 30 days since Apr 15, 2025 (minutes-2025-04-15.docx, carried 2-1). A motion for 7-day leases failed 1-2. Before that: six months (2019 house rules). From almanac v1.
On Friday and Saturday nights quiet hours start at 11:00 p.m., until 7:00 a.m., effective October 1, 2026 (minutes-2026-09-15.docx, carried 3-0). Other nights remain 10:00 p.m. From almanac v2.

On Tuesday nights quiet hours start at 10:00 p.m. and run to 7:00 a.m. (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, House Rule 6). The change in minutes-2026-09-15.docx applies to Friday and Saturday nights only. From almanac v2.

No, it was late. The minutes of Sep 10, 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf) asked the Secretary to send notice by January 30, 2026, which matches the 60-day notice period in contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf. The email notice is dated February 2, 2026 (email-2026-02-02-landscaping.txt), after the due date, so the agreement may have renewed automatically. This is not legal advice. From almanac v1.
The board approved heat pumps on balconies on January 23, 2025, motion carried 2-1 (minutes-2025-01-23.pdf). From almanac v1.
Guest vehicles may stay up to 48 hours, effective October 1, 2025 (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf, 3-0). Before that: 72 hours. From almanac v1.
Yes, in your assigned parking space, with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at your cost (minutes-2026-01-20.pdf, 3-0). From almanac v1.
By no more than 4% per renewal (contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf, clause 4). From almanac v1.
The almanac does not cover this. I can search the raw board folder if you want, labelled as unverified.
No. $235 was only proposed on the agenda of January 23, 2025; the minutes of that meeting (minutes-2025-01-23.pdf) amended it and adopted $225. From almanac v1.
The 35 lb limit for dogs was removed on April 15, 2025 (minutes-2025-04-15.docx, 3-0). From almanac v1.

1. Open conflict: pool hours for 2026 (minutes-2025-09-10 says 10:00 p.m.; notice-2026-05-01-pool says 9:00 p.m.). 2. Provisional: electric barbecues, from the June 2026 recording only. 3. Late action: landscaping non-renewal notice due Jan 30, 2026, sent Feb 2, 2026, after the due date; the agreement may have renewed to Mar 31, 2027. 4. Contract deadline: if renewed, the next non-renewal notice is due Jan 30, 2027.

Bylaws (Part A) need a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting; House Rules (Part B) can be changed by a majority vote of the board (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, Article 3). From almanac v1.

One pet per unit, and dogs may not exceed 35 pounds (bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf, House Rule 4). The corrected minutes of April 15, 2025 no longer contain the decision allowing two pets, so that rule was dropped in this version. From almanac v3.
On January 5, 2027 guest vehicles may stay up to 24 hours. The board adopted this on November 10, 2026 (minutes-2026-11-10.docx, carried 3-0), effective January 1, 2027. From almanac v3.

Guest vehicles may currently stay up to 48 hours (minutes-2025-09-10.pdf, effective October 1, 2025). A change to 24 hours is scheduled from January 1, 2027 (minutes-2026-11-10.docx, carried 3-0). From almanac v3.
